ns2:section.sectionText: Notes: Developing your Professional Portfolio. Students will build and improve their professional portfolio, including development of personal bios for a variety of audiences and experiences, resume, and online presence. This course is primarily designed for performance majors. Please complete the short online form for consideration to join this course: https://illinois.edu/fb/sec/7273636 Restrictions: Must be junior, senior, or graduate standing in music. Consent of the instructor.
ns2:section.sectionNotes: Restricted to students with Junior, Senior, or Graduate I class standing.
ns2:section.sectionDeptRestriction: Restricted to students in the Music department.
